Index file and folder names (never contents) so searches are instant. You can index everything on the internal storage, or choose the folders yourself.

When you search in a folder that contains your indexed folders but is not fully indexed, use only the indexed folders for instant results. Results can be incomplete. Off: use the slower, complete search.
